title: Sorting and Binary Search Challenge #1: Rotated Sorted Array Search
statement: Given an input configuration, implement an optimal algorithm to solve the Rotated Sorted Array Search problem for Sorting and Binary Search. `solve(nums: list) -> int`.
explanation: Solves the problem using an optimal Rotated Sorted Array Search technique under Sorting and Binary Search.
commonMistakes: Boundary indexing errors on empty or single-element inputs.
